scope: mathematical kernel, plot coordinates, local sampling and proof fields

criteria.check: All seven discrete and ten continuous families checked against SciPy with moments, mass or density, CDF, survival, interval and quantiles.
Standard normal CDF at zero equals 0.5 and Binomial(10,0.5) mass at five equals 0.24609375.
Complementarity, monotonicity, exact fair-binomial jumps, million-trial binomial center, large Beta shapes and mpmath extreme tails.
Event relationships, conditional probabilities, Bayes, zero conditioning and invalid joint probability.
Seed replay, sample support and plot coordinates verified against SciPy for all seventeen families.
Degenerate, unsupported, malformed, duplicate and excessive requests respect documented outcomes or stable errors.
Fifty-seven target cases with identical proof metadata and strict binary64 tolerance when numeric fields differ.
